reviews.x: This is a plastic comb, I was under the impression that this comb was actually made of carbon fiber or a metal for the price. There’s other more reasonably American made plastic combs for a tenth of the cost.

I was once like you.  A comb's a comb a comb.  Sometimes they hand out combs for free at the barber after a bad haircut.  Until I was gifted this at a bachelor party, and it changed my whole perspective. Somehow, you didn't think the 30 seconds of your life each day could be so much more.  Perfectly space teeth, hole grip (don't even talk to me until you've tried it), light and looks cool.  $15 / 30 seconds x 365 days x lifetime = the best deal per sensual stroke than anything else available for

I got this for backpacking. Do I really need a comb in the mountains? Not really. But it sure is nice to have one and a luxury item at only 10 grams (~1/3 ounce) is no bother to carry. It appears to be fairly strong but I would still be careful as it's likely to break, not bend. Also, colder temperature may have a greater effect on it. I wasn't sure about the design but after trying it, I use that hole all the time.
This is a very well made high quality comb. Highly recommend!!

reviews.t: It's a great comb, it's fun to play with too!
reviews.x: OK, I tend to criticize weird reviews. Like, "Doesn't this person have anything better to do?" Yet, I'm writing a review of a COMB. The product description says what you need to know. Strong, light, smooth, ultimate comb. The tines are the proper distance apart, not too close like a dime-store comb. (Alert GenX and younger, Dime-stores, aka 5 and 10 cent stores, were sort of like Dollar stores, but yet not).  The little circle lets you put your finger through it for extra stability and hours of

I take this comb everywhere I go. It’s super fidgety and works great. Fits in most pockets specially pants and jeans. I would not recommend using it on the back pocket and siting down on it, it’s sturdy but if enough pressure is applied I think it would break. It would most definitely won’t break under normal use. It’s light that you will barely notice is there. The bristles don’t stab your head while you comb, instead it feels great. Nice comb I highly recommend for an EDC comb.

This is a very nice comb! The sheath just adds to the classy look of the comb. The "bristles" are very ferm. There is a little flex to the comb itself, but in all it is very sturdy.  The sheath is great looking. The company who collabed with Chicago Comb to make the sheath makes high end leather wallets and other goods. So you know this thing is of great quality.  I am happy both the comb and sheath are made in the USA  I would highly recommend this comb.

This is a perfect sized comb! I was worried it would be too small but it's perfect. Not as long as a barber style comb and the loop allows for better handling and even hanging. The teeth are about a medium spacing not super fine but not thick spaced either. The carbon fiber feels like plastic but you can tell its not because it is much stronger and has low flex.

Never thought I’d care about a comb, let alone write a review about it but dang this is a great comb! Exceptionally well made, lightweight and easy to hold, great for traveling too. I have thick wavy hair and it gets all the tangled out.

reviews.t: Best comb ever, and very inexpensive
reviews.x: I thought this comb was cheap, and it is nice quality, smooth carbon fibre, plus has the little finger handle.  I love it and don't need the dual-pitch type normal comb, this single-pitch comb is perfect.
The plastic feels rather flimsy. Was expecting a little higher quality. My other Kent comb will stay as my go-to.

reviews.t: Super LIGHT & Strong, PERFECT for Pocket/Travel!
reviews.x: Great comb, Super LIGHT, Perfect for traveling!  Bends slightly but strong.

This comb is very high quality, thick, sturdy, and smooth. The size is right and the spread in the tines is great. The material seems nice, although the carbon fiber is not all that discernible from quality plastic as far as look and feel. All in all I like this comb quite a bit; however, I admit that I slightly prefer my Kent comb. After going back and forth, I believe this is mostly due to fact that the glossier, and slightly more compliant Kent gildes more smoothly. In any case it’s a comb an

I needed a comb that I can toss into a gym bag and can handle some beating. I've been using this for a month now and still looks new. The widths of the teeth make it easy to clean and you don't get any product build up or hair stuck on it. I have pretty short hair so was worried the wider teeth wouldn't comb properly, but works just fine.  I like the circular hole on the top of the comb, makes it easy to grab with your finger and get a more precise look. Even though I got it for the gym, it repl

reviews.t: I never thought I'd buy a $12 pocket comb!
reviews.x: But boy am I happy I did! I usually use one of those disposable generic 5" black pocket combs, and suffer the sharp tines, weak or too stiff construction. Now, though, with this carbon fiber Chicago Comb No.1, it all just works. Lightweight and stiff with just a touch of flex, finely crafted tines that never poke or scratch, it's great! Try it, you'll like it!

Wanted a nice comb as i kept losing the $3 ones from the stores. Much smoother and nicer to use, and quite durable so far(i spin it on the loop so it takes quite a few falls). Plus youll want to keep track of it unlike a normal comb

reviews.t: Best quality comb on the market
reviews.x: Excellent quality and design.  Unique in the industry and made in the USA!  It’s a must.

reviews.t: Perfect comb for thick long beards.
reviews.x: I love this comb and I don't let just anything touch my beard. The tines are perfectly spaced, sturdy and have proper depth to comb smoothly through my lions main of a beard. I'm talking a foot long with thick curly hairs Viking kind if beard. The ends are satisfactorily narrow unlike wooden combs that can leave gaps with each pass. This comb is compact enough for a breast pocket on a shirt or jacket and light enough to be comfortable in soft exercise shorts. The price is right for the quality a

reviews.t: Great in-pocket comb, understated but classy !
reviews.x: Only just received this last few days, so early days yet regarding durability, etc. All I can say from initial use is its just what I need. Compact,  light, smooth teeth which do not either catch up in my hair or scratch my scalp. The finger loop in one end is a really clever piece of ergonomic design.. gives a secure grip point on what is quite a short comb. I'm hoping that durability will match the clever design - first comb I have purchased made from carbon fibre, but - so far - I just love i

Sorry to bring you in with the BUYER BEWARE but this is the best comb I've ever used. The only way your gonna break it is with some serious will power to bend it. Absolutely my favorite comb rigid enough to shape any pomade and thick hair without bending and and ruining a style while also flexible enough to no hurt the scalp. I use it more then daily it is in my pocket when ever I go anywhere for the past 2 months. Fantastic comb for a great price

I will only buy this brand of combs! I found them during a Kickstarter project and was hooked the moment I received my order!  I have now expanded my comb selection to have the well-made handle and bigger comb! Fantastic product all-around! It makes my hair look great and is beneficial for my scalp!

Best, non-plastic, durable comb you can buy for the money. It has become my favorite go-to comb because of its compact size and durability and it does not cause static electricity when I use it on my unruly hair. It is a well-made carbon fiber comb. Now if only l could stop losing it. Hah.

I backed their kickstarter and got this comb and their Model 6. I got the leather sheaths that paired with them. Unfortunately my daughter likes to take my combs and both have now been lost. Now I'm back here buying them again.
It's very smooth with no static. It's a little pricey for a comb, but it's nice. Keep in mind it's a carbon fiber blend, not 100% carbon fiber so I will break in a back pocket.
This might be the best pocket comb ever. I’ve carried one in my back pocket for years and it’s never bent or broken. The teeth are nicely spaced and it’s a great comb.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the comb as lightweight and well-suited for travel, pockets, and everyday carry.
Many reviewers describe the comb as high quality, sturdy, and well made, though a few note it feels flimsy or likely to break under pressure.
Several reviewers note the carbon fiber material looks and feels similar to plastic, and some expected metal or carbon fiber rather than plastic for the price.
Reviewers commonly highlight the tine spacing and smoothness as comfortable and effective, including for thick or wavy hair.
A few reviewers mention the comb is fun to fidget with and appreciate the finger loop or sheath.
